venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative:
**CCATL — Friday, July 17, 2026** (MOD: MKZ/JK, entered by Mya)

Happy Friday! Had some rain to start the day up but it cleared by evening. Lull to the start of the day but let's make sure we are pointing out our Summer Friday deal.

No mid bartender today. Stage came in from 5pm to 8pm. Closers and barback came in at 8pm. Lean into tableside service whenever possible.

Reservation at 8:45pm for Lily Bass went smoothly. DJ followed in not long after; he stayed until close.

Let's continue to follow SOP for starting up checks. Saw lots of new faces tonight. Great job getting from behind the bar throughout the night.

Big pop around 10:30pm with a wedding coming from the Forth Hotel. Opener stayed until 1am — thank you so much. Night went smoothly.

We will need to put some coupes and Collins glasses on the floor.

**Kitchen:** Smooth night. Thanks for all the help with FOH. Let's keep up to date with the new hot dog build.

**86'd/Low:** 86 towels.

**Favorite moment:** The wedding from the Forth — they enjoyed themselves!

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.weather: Hot and humid with brief rain
venues.narrative:
**CCNSH — Friday, July 17, 2026** (MOD & Chef: KK/KE & JMS, entered by JO)

Decent Friday night! Slow start to service, once again only around $700 in sales from 4pm-7pm until we picked up around 9pm where we did the bulk of our sales until 11:30pm. We did have a non-event incident that occurred at the end of the night (see Kala).

**Comps:** $110.30 / 1.2%.

**Kitchen:** Lower food sales tonight. John-Michael held it down per usual!

**Events:** Our 40th birthday party had a great time and were with us for a few hours!

**Favorite moment:** Kala is back! As always having her in the mix with the crew is just a joy. Fun night with the team!

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative:
**DVR — Friday, July 17, 2026** (AM MOD: Maggie H & Josh; PM MOD: Carey & Lucas, entered by Carey)

**Sales split:** DC/AM $1,069.33 | D&C (PM) $18,944.75 | Garden/6A $4,864.58. Total net $20,014.08 vs target $18,575 (+7.7%). Comps $630.47 / 3.08%. 414 guests (Tock).

**D&C Notes:** Nicely paced night that never really felt busy, but boy we sure were. We knocked out over 400 guests in the lobby, & the Garden was cranking it all night long!

**DC/AM Notes:** Fridayyy — started out super steady and became pretty quiet around noon. Thank you Jordyn!

**Garden / 6A:** The day started off very slow and picked up midway through, stayed very steady after that. Pretty chill overall — lost a soldier (Minsu H) and gained a helper (Sam Young). Much love to the crew; thanks Cosette, Jordan, and Graham for helping with the close.

**Kitchen:** Chill night with Lucas, Rachel, and Isaias with a little dinner pop. Thanks Rand!

**Incident:** Injury/incident reported — Yes (see report).

**Favorite moment:** Super fun & fast-paced night! Having an extra body on the floor in the form of training and another learning the support ropes — Ryan & Kyle were never in the way but huge assets to tonight's service. Mad respect for them stepping in on such a nice Friday evening.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative:
**EV — Friday, July 17, 2026** (MOD & Chef: Kyler & Steves, entered by Thomas; report submitted 7/18 afternoon, backfilled on 7/19 pass)

**Sales:** Beverage $7,691 | Food $806 | Retail $80. Total net $8,577 vs target $7,651 (+12.1%). 234 covers, 8 large parties, 7 solos, zero investor cocktails. Comps $130 (mostly DNLs).

**Service Notes:** While a crush of 8pm and 10pm reservations crimped our ability to fully fill out the room, we maintained a high-paced flow with only intermittent pauses. It was quite common for there to be seven tickets on the board, and nearly constantly one or two. Lots of mini narratives within a maelstrom of covers — introducing a novice to the Clover Club, Stef selling books to some mega fans, a four-cocktail sequence for a gentleman who decided to bartend after meeting Tiff at the Texas Welcome Home pop-up. Massive shoutout to Kyler crushing it on the door with the always charismatic Ellis. Shoutout to Puma for hosting a free concert series at A-1, driving foot traffic to unprecedented levels.

**Top sellers:** Native Lion, Rosalie, Burner Phone.

**Door Notes:** From a pretty mild start with a block party outside to a very solid crusher of an evening. As 8pm hit we grew a mile-long waitlist. 8pm and 10pm reservations made the turns a little tricky, but everybody wanted to keep hanging out with us. Lots of industry visiting from around the U.S., and our own Seth Hiravy got to do some dreamweaving for guests. From 8pm until 1:30am the team crushed a full room and made it look effortless. Kudos to Thomas Van de Pas, Stefania Gonzalez, Peter Tait, and Jane Nam.

**No-shows (unable to charge):** Erik Budo Uerkwitz (2 at 8pm), Alyssa Aubuchon (3 at 10pm).

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative:
**LA — Friday, July 17, 2026** (MOD & Chef: Gigi & Josh/Saleh, entered by Gigi)

**Sales split:** Standing Room $2,577 (food $316) | Marquee $8,158 (food $1,415). Total net $10,735 vs target $11,961.

**D&C Notes:** A very very slow first couple of hours allowed us to get all the breaks out of the way early on. Around 9pm we started filling up and got a huge rush until about 11pm — non-stop. Small lull, then picked right back up until midnight. We didn't have many reservations and were able to seat a whole lot of walk-ins. We got creative in SR and Marquee with extra stools and chairs. Lots of friends and fam came to say hello. Xavier worked his first weekend shift in Marquee; Natalie and Gigi rocked the host stand all night. Chef helped break security and stayed upstairs to help with crowd control. SR tables were full most of the night; we accommodated several large parties at the Marquee bar and a few 6-tops at 24/25 with extra chairs. Super dramatic slowdown after midnight — only about 4 new parties. Closed SR at 12, first server off the floor at 12:30am. Guests loved the fresh AC — the first 5 parties complimented the smell of the bar. Big shoutout to the entire team for rocking it with a skeleton crew!

**Kitchen:** Consistent flow for food tickets tonight. Big shoutout to Saleh for last-minute orders. We pushed lamb burgers and oysters tonight!

**Comps:** $396.70 — service recovery (spilled drink, long ticket time), gifts for celebrations & friends, Matty, Big Bob, Chris Adams (member), Sam from Knotted Cafe (she brought treats!), DNLs.

**Maintenance:** Critters.

**Favorite moment:** Multiple hugs and high-fives from guests. Edwin met a couple whose son's memory is commemorated by a tree at the Ace Hotel — Edwin used to take care of that tree during his time there. Small world.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative:
**DC — Friday, July 17, 2026** (MOD: Marcus / Josh, entered by Josh)

**Garden:** Closed due to heatwave and poor air quality.

**D&C Notes:** Busy night in Marquee with steady foot traffic throughout the evening. Due to the extreme heat and poor air quality, we made the decision earlier in the day to keep the Garden closed and instead use the space to temporarily hold guests while tables were cleared and seats became available.

Overall, the pacing of the room was solid but communication and verbiage at the door could have been tighter. We had a few guests sitting for over three hours while a waitlist continued to grow, which meant we had to get more creative with seating opportunities. Marcus stepped in to help manage the door and work guests into the room without turning people away. We'll discuss strategies for managing those situations at tomorrow's pre-shift.

With three servers on the floor, service ran smoothly. The team did a great job checking in on guests and keeping water glasses full. One area to improve is ticket pacing — let's not flood the bar with orders all at once. That said, the bar team maintained quick ticket times, communicated, passed tickets, and jumped out to bus the bar top. A strong night for DC that exceeded the daily sales target.

**Guests:** 232 total. Comps $158.40 (1.72%); voids $94.60 (1%).

**Kitchen:** Steady night. Maria did an amazing job handling the line — tickets to spec and very quick. Shoutout James running food and knocking out the dish pit.

**Went well:** Ticket times, hustle, table touches. **Do better:** Adjustments on the fly, product knowledge, ticket pacing (floor), door comms.

**Favorite moment:** Grant pushing Chartreuse VEP Swizzles.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative:
**MG — Friday, July 17, 2026** (AM: Sam & Lex/Shannon; PM: Justin & Shannon/Drew, entered by Alexis)

**Sales split:** MB Morning $1,638 | MB Evening $10,313 | Sun Club $625 | Hot Eye $3,013. Total net $15,543 vs target $10,000 (+55.4%). Guests: 59 AM + 256 PM (OpenTable). Comps $515.

**Morning MB:** Pretty quiet breakfast, but a strong 12-2 period. Chandler, Tia, and Catie did a great job with the push and large parties — a 9-top, an 8, and two ~15-person tours. Kitchen set themselves up well for the new menu.

**Evening MB:** Happy hour was steady busy into dinner. Got hit with a wave at 7:00, followed by a couple MAX large parties at 7:30. From then until kitchen closing we were at max capacity, bar and floor! Short waitlist; sat everyone that waited. Culinary rocked a full ticket rail for hours. Bar is short on SOF glassware — many cocktails went out in the DOF instead.

**Sun Club:** Slow day; mostly swimmers, but lots of frozen strawberry drinks. Out of High Noons (3 left upstairs, no backup).

**Hot Eye:** What a night — full house by 9:30 with tons of locals in for the Brother Vinyl set. 10pm was over capacity and sardine-packed before leveling out. Ran out of citrus at one point; MG shared all their cheaters. One big dance party until the lights came on. Temp hit 81 — several guest comments about the heat.

**Kitchen:** A good old-fashioned butt kicking. The grill was absolutely obliterated the last 90 minutes, but not a single burger or steak cooked incorrectly — well done Drew! FOH and support did an excellent job running food. 8 Branzino until Monday, otherwise set on product.

**Maintenance:** Housekeeping to the Hot Eye floors.

**Favorite moment:** Justin's bestie Quinna in with regulars for a late dinner. Lena Dechamp's bachelorette group dressed to the nines. Drew crushing it on grill, and THE throwing the best dance party yet!
